name: frac-first-30-days-diagnostic
description: Structures the first 30 days of a fractional engagement into the two or three questions the diagnostic must answer, an interview guide, an evidence log, a written assessment with findings marked observed, reported or inferred, a ranked list of initiatives, one or two early wins and the day-30 readout. Use for "run frac-first-30-days-diagnostic", "first 30 days as a fractional executive", "day 30 assessment", "diagnostic for a new client", "first 90 days", "turn my interview notes into an assessment", "what should my first month produce", part of the Claude for Fractional Leaders Pack by 90n.
